title: Ralph golden review manifest
description: Separate review manifest for golden baseline changes. Every working-tree change to a file under a golden directory declared by .factory/golden-policy.json requires exactly one entry here recording the before hash (committed at HEAD), the after hash (new working-tree content), the reason, and the reviewer's human identity. Documentation or a bare commit message can never substitute for the manifest entry.

before_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed golden at HEAD; null when the file is new (not present at HEAD).

after_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the working-tree golden; null when the file was deleted.
